title: Asking for help
examples: If I fall down, who should I tell?
What words can I use when I need help?
Is it okay to ask a grown-up for help?

explain.say: Everyone needs help sometimes. Asking for help is a good thing to do.
A trusted grown-up can help you. This can be a parent, a carer or a teacher.
Go to the grown-up. Say their name. Then say, I need help, please.
Then say what the help is for. For example, my lunchbox is stuck.
You can also point, sign or show a picture. If you are hurt or scared, tell a grown-up straight away.

items: Point, sign or show a picture

draw.text: Hurt or scared? Tell a grown-up straight away.

faq.q: Who is it okay to ask for help?
faq.a: You can ask a trusted grown-up, like a parent, a carer or a teacher. These are people who help keep you safe.

faq.q: What if I don't know what to say?
faq.a: You can point and say, I need help. Those words are enough to start.
asks: What if I forget my words?

faq.q: Do I have to use my words?
faq.a: Words help, but you can also point, sign, show a picture or use a talking device. Any way you show that you need help is okay.

faq.q: Can I ask two people for help?
faq.a: Yes. If the first grown-up is busy, you can ask another trusted grown-up.
asks: Is it too much to ask?

faq.q: What if the grown-up is busy?
faq.a: You can wait a little bit and try again. You can gently remind them that you need help.

facts: Telling a grown-up when you are hurt is important.
Saying 'please' and 'thank you' helps when you ask for things.
Trusted adults are people who keep you safe.
Using your words helps people understand your feelings.

quiz.say: Your tower falls down. You feel upset. Tap who can help.
quiz.why: Your teacher is a trusted grown-up. Teachers can help you feel better and build again.

wrong.0: A toy box holds toys, and a grown-up is the one who can help.
wrong.2: A teddy is nice to hug, and a grown-up can help you fix things.

quiz.say: A jigsaw is hard. Tap the kind words to ask for help.
quiz.why: These words are kind. They tell the grown-up what you need.

wrong.1: These words sound bossy, so adding please and asking works better.
wrong.2: These words send the helper away just when you need them.

quiz.say: You fall and hurt your knee. Tap the best thing to do.
quiz.why: A grown-up can look at your knee. They can help it feel better.

wrong.0: Hiding makes it hard for a grown-up to find you and help.
wrong.1: Your knee needs looking after, so tell a grown-up first.
